name: Valle de Oro National Wildlife Refuge
description: A 570-acre urban national wildlife refuge in Albuquerque's South Valley. The refuge provides restored habitat, trails, wildlife observation, outdoor learning, and conservation education opportunities along the Rio Grande.

name: Los Padillas Elementary School
address: 2525 Los Padillas Road SW Albuquerque NM 87105
description: APS elementary school serving PreK–5 and part of the Sustaining the Future Environmental STEM pathway. The school has a five-acre Los Padillas Wildlife Sanctuary directly on campus, which APS describes as an outdoor experiential education facility and ecological teaching tool. Students explore habitats, wildlife, ecological systems, stewardship, birding, wetlands, and the Albuquerque bosque through hands-on learning.
